metadata.description: Scan verified domains, follow live progress and review the security findings for your applications.

home.badge: Sprint 2 · data layer, authentication and scanning
home.title: Vulnerability intelligence for the stacks you actually ship.
home.intro: VulDetected scans a target, normalises what it finds, and tells you which vulnerabilities are real for your stack. Authentication, domain ownership verification and live scan progress work today; CVE correlation and integrations come later.

items.schema: PostgreSQL schema with five tables and generated migrations
items.hashing: Passwords hashed with argon2id at OWASP minimum parameters
items.audit: Append-only audit log, enforced by a database trigger
items.lockout: Progressive account lockout and user-enumeration-safe errors
items.ownership: Domain ownership verification by DNS TXT record or /.well-known/ file
items.scanQueue: Scan queueing for verified domains, with a per-user rate limit
items.scanChecks: Security header, TLS, cookie and redirect checks
items.liveProgress: Live progress over server-sent events, with findings recorded per scan

notBuilt.title: Not built yet
notBuilt.description: CVE correlation and integrations are not built yet. Everything else on this page works today: you can verify a domain, queue a scan, follow its progress live and review the findings it records.

dev.title: What this build does
dev.intro: Live rows below are read from PostgreSQL during this request. Declared values are configuration this codebase commits to.

live.title: Live — read from the database
live.description: Empty values mean no session, which is the expected state for a visitor who has not signed in.

declared.title: Declared — configuration, not verified state
declared.description: Values below are literals from the source. They state intent; they do not read the live cookie or the live environment.

controls.sessionCookieValue: HttpOnly · SameSite=Lax · Secure off only for http

plaintext.title: Session and verification tokens are stored in plaintext
plaintext.description: Better Auth derives the session cookie from the token it reads back from the database, so hashing at rest would put the digest in the cookie. Documented as Open in docs/security.md; the mitigations are a 7-day absolute expiry, real revocation, and account-state hooks.

rateLimit.title: No rate limiting at the edge yet
rateLimit.description: Per-account lockout exists, but there is no IP-level limiter in front of the auth route. Server-side throttling is a Sprint 2 item and is required before this is exposed publicly.
